description: Unexecuted template (PR-VID-MOTION-420). Bind your own images and driving videos, then replace each case's alignment numbers with the alignment you accepted in Align Motion for that exact source image and driver (an alignment never transfers to another subject). Both arms share the seed, workflow, version, length, controls, original driver and temporal frame selection; only the spatial alignment differs. A physical run needs the owner's separate authorization. Pilot: one representative position case, aligned versus unaligned (2 jobs).

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in a dark jacket, standing in a plain studio, full figure, photorealistic

motion.action: Raises the right hand to shoulder height and waves twice, then lowers it.
motion.motion_prompt: the person raises their right hand, waves twice and lowers it, body otherwise still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject waves with their right hand twice and lowers it; the body, face and background stay still and nothing is duplicated.
